[[Prismatic Champion's Regalia]] is a [[legendary trinket]] obtainable through the {{achievement icon|Current Events#achievement5790}} meta achievement in [[Living World Season 2]], [[Living World Season 3|Season 3]], [[Living World Season 4|Season 4]] and [[The Icebrood Saga]]. All episodes of the aforementioned [[Living World#Seasons|Living World seasons]] must be unlocked to be able to complete the achievement that rewards this item.

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|[[Pact Commander|Your]] adventures before we met, and our struggles together—this is the strength from our bond, [[Aurene|my]] [[Dragon champion|champion]].}}

== Acquisition ==
{{Achievement list|reward=Prismatic Champion's Regalia}}

== Graphics ==
{{YouTube search}}
* The wearer is surrounded by a shimmering faint rainbow-colored glow. They also emit star-like sparks that rapidly fade.
* The wearer leaves behind a trail of sparks of different colors as they walk.
* When drawing weapons, a burst of light explodes from the wearer's chest.

== Notes ==
* The visual effects can be disabled.
* The fourth PvE legendary trinket, [[Prismatic Champion's Regalia]], was released on [[Game updates/2021-11-30|November 30, 2021]] with the final update of [[Living World Return]].

== Trivia ==
* Previously there was a container shown as the achievement reward named [[Prismatic Champion's Inheritance]] which was replaced, with this amulet, before it could be acquired.
